# Welcome {.unnumbered}

*Artificial Intelligence* is an open textbook spanning classical problem solving, knowledge and uncertainty, modern machine learning, perception, generative systems, responsible practice, deployment, and emerging directions.

## Intended audience

The book is designed for undergraduate or beginning graduate learners who want a broad, technically grounded introduction to artificial intelligence. Readers benefit from basic programming familiarity; individual chapters identify and explain the mathematical ideas they use.

## Learning purpose

The chapters combine conceptual explanations, terminology, worked examples, implementation patterns, discussion questions, and further reading. They may be read sequentially as a course text or selected independently for focused study.

## Open educational resource

This textbook is provided as an open educational resource. You may retain, reuse, revise, remix, and redistribute it under the [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), provided appropriate attribution is given.
